population: All recorded teaching queries of the original six P1 TRAIN episodes, in episode order. Separate episode, family, layout hash, task, seed. No validation/test allocation or success rate for student.
inputs: Byte-verified original current stereo at teacher query (every 250 native ticks). Exact reset and 8 integer-second body observations from same episode; cross-check overlapping archived pixels and all sixteen old policy inputs. Measured right flange from actual query-time mount/TCP and bilateral width; same registered OOD left substitutes. Only original language reaches model.
labels: Retain raw geometric task intent and full nominal H40 in world frame. For processor compatibility evaluate its 20Hz knots at exact k/30 for 0<=k<50, using linear translation, shortest-arc SLERP and left-constant nominal gripper events. No reintegration, suffix extension, previous or future-query splicing. Keep original H40, physical atom receipts and observed achieved TCP separate. The 30Hz representation omits nominal time after 49/30 s. Report event timing and all events beyond this support.
audit: Join each confirmed original native interval to exact wire hash, ticks, installed EEF10, achieved TCP and target contact, object grasp and previous teacher gripper command. Privileged truth audit only. Verify round-trip through pinned ARX training sample transform incl re-pack, normalization, model padding and official output decoder. Report all out-of-checkpoint action support by coordinate. A virtual left arm and padding are not target supervision. This is a data qualification, training disabled.
